laws.k: domestic-workers|CL|Law No. 20.786 on household workers' hours, rest and pay
laws.t: Law No. 20.786 on household workers' hours, rest and pay
laws.tp: Hours, rest days, registration of contracts and a ban on in-kind deductions.
laws.s2: Jam kerja, hari istirahat, pendaftaran kontrak, dan larangan memotong upah dengan barang.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights
coded.n: Labor Code chapter on domestic work, reformed 2014.

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Written contract within 15 days, registered with the labor directorate.

coded.vl: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: In-kind pay may not be deducted.

coded.vl: Normal hours limited as for other workers
coded.n: 45 hours for live-out workers; 12 hours' rest for live-in workers.

coded.vl: At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
coded.n: Sunday rest, Saturdays for live-in workers.

coded.vl: Equal to or longer than for other workers
coded.n: Annual leave as for other workers.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
Included in the general social security system, including maternity

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only
May form and join trade unions
